answer: A quartz crystal carries one frequency per operator, and a knoll audit measures every crystal at the zenith of the epoch. Each identity registers one crystal, backed by a 400,000 POA bond. Two crystals resonating at the same frequency belong to one operator, and both are voided at once. Their rewards burn, the bonds pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
